---
title: Needs fixture
description: Fixture for the needs marker of fragments.
---

An honest marker for a package the repo lacks:

```tsx fragment="needs not-installed-pkg"
import { thing } from "not-installed-pkg";
import { DataGridRoot } from "@/components/data-grid/data-grid";

void thing;
void DataGridRoot;
```

A marker for a package the block does not import:

```tsx fragment="needs left-pad-missing"
import { DataGridRoot } from "@/components/data-grid/data-grid";

void DataGridRoot;
```

A marker for an installed package:

```tsx fragment="needs react"
import { useState } from "react";

void useState;
```

A marker that hides a missing registry import:

```tsx fragment="needs not-installed-pkg"
import { thing } from "not-installed-pkg";
import { Nope } from "@/components/data-grid/does-not-exist";

void thing;
void Nope;
```
